name: @mobiusx/mcp-client
description: Broader MCP tool support (source requirement §28): reads a project's .mobiusx/mcp.json, spawns each enabled server over real stdio (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk — the actual Model Context Protocol, not a reimplementation), and exposes a namespaced tool list + tool-call, shared by apps/desktop-agent (Settings UI: connect/list) and apps/cloud-agent-gateway (actually calling a tool mid-task).
